notes:
NDM 2.3.7 brings update checks out of the app. Until now, NDM only learned about a new release when you opened it and it checked. 2.3.7 registers a small check with the operating system at sign-in — an autostart entry on Linux, a scheduled task on Windows installer builds — so a new version is announced even while NDM is closed.

The announcement is a single centered window in the app's own glass finish: the new version, what you are running now, and the release notes, with Update Now and Later. Update Now downloads and installs in that same window, with progress, and reopens NDM when it is done — the same install machinery the in-app updater has always used, not a second path. Later dismisses that version for 24 hours, not forever. If NDM is already running when the check fires, the checker stays silent and the in-app offer owns the announcement.

This release also fixes the browser download card on small screens. The card could grow taller than the display — on a 1366×768 screen at 125% scaling it stood 602 px in a content area about 500 px high, and the Download button sat off-screen with no way to reach it. The card now caps at the screen's height, its middle scrolls, and the action bar stays pinned at the bottom at every window size.
